scope: Model/editor Product Quality v2 naturalness polish of EN-A1-L-0079; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: Character prompts and English distractors were re-read as complete learner-facing utterances; teacher directives and known ungrammatical generated distractors were removed.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Persian copy consistently renders end as the endpoint of a route or place.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: One concrete bounded noun sense is practiced in two simple location frames.

distractorQuality.evidence: Wrong English options are grammatical/natural alternatives that differ on meaning, action, referent, quantity, polarity or context instead of using broken substitutions.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Character turns now ask or react in ways that pragmatically license the learner response rather than instructing the learner to repeat a line.

difficultyFit.evidence: The target remains within short A1 location language.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: The noun returns across listening, recognition, guided response and hidden retrieval.

transferQuality.evidence: The learner moves from describing a location to giving a waiting instruction.

overallCoherence.evidence: Scenario, target constructions and retrieval task align.

learnerExperience.evidence: No real learner test is claimed; engagement and perceived difficulty remain unverified.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
